construction_assumptions: The unsupported linear CCO centers in species 12/13 are replaced by bent 120 degree trial geometries. This is an explicit construction assumption, not a measured Fe(110) equilibrium angle.
Existing covalent bond lengths, exact connectivity and H placement are preserved by rotating whole O/OH branches.
Bond/angle/contact windows are conservative initial-seed screening heuristics, not an electronic-structure or stability acceptance protocol.
Source-provenance energies are not inherited by any changed structure.
The nine other initial structures are retained only after the same expanded audit; unchanged POSCAR bytes are preserved.
